goal: CREATE A NEW tabletop barcode-inspection and indexing machine by recombining useful subsystems of multiple UNRELATED broken/surplus devices: LS2208 scanner, Epson LQ-680 printer carriage, QNAP TS-219P II motherboard, and Apple mouse switches. Required functions: barcode detection, controlled object indexing, local processing, manual stop/input; explain missing components and conditions. Do not restore any original device.
